description: program (a) verbatim: everything compiles but the `not` arm's `"length " + @inputVal.length`, which the S440 operator rule refuses.
rationale: `+` takes two numbers or two strings (ruled S440, Gotcha Q1). The fix is an explicit conversion, which the bootstrap does not have yet (no method calls, no template literals): the next wall for program (a)-like code.
